items.title: Mood Symptoms Linked to Disturbed Eating in Adults With T1D
items.summary: Disturbed eating behavior is associated with increased depressive and anxiety symptoms among adults with type 1 diabetes, a Turkish study shows. Medscape Medical News

items.title: Most Kids in ICU With Severe RSV Have No Prior Health Issues
items.summary: A study of children aged 8-23 months in pediatric ICU for severe RSV finds that most have no underlying health conditions, but those eligible for nirsevimab most often need ventilator support. Medscape Medical News

items.title: Theory-Based Nursing Care Is Linked to Better Self-Management
items.summary: A meta-analysis links theory-based nursing interventions to better self-management, mental health, health literacy, and quality of life in patients with chronic diseases. Medscape Medical News

items.title: Lyme Disease Vaccine Shows 73% Efficacy
items.summary: Efficacy of an investigational Lyme disease vaccine waned by the third Lyme disease season, suggesting annual booster shots may be needed to maintain protection. Medscape Medical News

items.title: Longer or Repeat Cytisinicline Helps Smokers and Vapers Quit
items.summary: A failed quit attempt does not rule out success with another course of cytisinicline, including among patients who previously took the drug, researchers say. Medscape Medical News

items.title: Certain RA Drugs Linked to Higher Risk for Herpes Zoster
items.summary: Patients with rheumatoid arthritis have a higher incidence of herpes zoster than the general population, with the highest rates seen in those receiving JAK inhibitors, a large Swedish study shows. Medscape News UK
